failure.title: Programme load editing dereferenced a cleared React event target
failure.note: The retained pre-fix component and behavior test reproduce TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading value) after two related mutation-page checks had passed.
failure.diagnosis: The load input read event.currentTarget.value inside a deferred setState updater. React had cleared currentTarget before that updater executed, so editing a prescribed load could crash the programme editor.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
